Aggregate readiness passing by 2.2 percentage points and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, while the public risk-management and model-card guidance support monitoring and explicit disclosure of residual limitations. output.claims_about_policy: The governing policy text distinguishes clean certification from caveated certification. Clean certification requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. That standard is not met because the tax filing assistant weakness remains unresolved and the runbook is still draft with TBD owner and threshold. The same policy also indicates that draft monitoring can support risk management but does not eliminate the current disclosure requirement unless approved. On this record, the supportable policy position is certification only if the packet is framed with an explicit caveat and disclosure of the named-use-case limitation unless an approved risk acceptance exists.
